thread:
zoe (PM): Quick sync — we need a compact rollout + holdback decision protocol for the multi-region model switch next week. Thinking: staged canaries -> 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% with a 10% persistent holdback in EU for 3 days. Thoughts?
ajay (Eng): +1 to gradual ramps. Need to pin model v tags and a fallback variant (smaller quantized) if latency or error spikes. Also who flips flags?
linh (Runtime): We can auto-fallback to v1-quant when p50 latency > 220ms or 5xx rate > 0.8% over a 5m window. Suggest canary window = 30m.
sam (SRE): Add an availability gate: if error budget burn > 15% in 1h, immediate rollback. Also require health checks from each region (control plane + runtime).
priya (ProdOps): For A/B analysis, we'll need consistent sampling keys to avoid cross-cohort leakage. Propose feature flag key: rollout/region-switch/{customer_id:mod100} for deterministic holdback.
emma (Data): We'll publish the metrics dashboard: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, model-quality delta (BLEU/QA-F1 on smoke prompts), and cost delta. Can we add a null-hypothesis check for output drift?
zoe (PM): Good — include quality gate: if quality delta drops by > 2% on production prompt set for 1h, pause rollout. Who owns the pause action?
ajay (Eng): Engineering will auto-toggle flags for canary ramps. Human-in-loop for pause/unpause: SRE + Oncall PM must ack(false) in runbook page before continuing.
linh (Runtime): Config snippet for the rollout policy (we'll push to infra config repo):
```
rollout:
  stages: [ {pct:2, window:30m}, {pct:10, window:30m}, {pct:30, window:60m}, {pct:100, window:120m} ]
  holdbacks: { EU: 10% }
  fallback: v1-quant
  gates: { latency_p50_ms: 220, error_rate_pct: 0.8, quality_drop_pct: 2 }
  abort_if: { error_budget_burn_pct: 15 }
```
sam (SRE): Runbook steps: 1) Start stage 1, notify #oncall and #product, 2) monitor dashboards + logs, 3) if any gate trips, execute fallback script: `./deploy/fallback.sh v1-quant`, 4) postmortem if manual abort.
priya (ProdOps): A/B flags: we should tag cohorts for 6 metrics (latency, quality, cost, retention, errors, conversions) and holdback cohort = control. We'll run a 48h statistical test for the top 3 metrics before 100% roll.
emma (Data): For quick checks we use uplift tests with bootstrap CI. I'll create the notebook and link in the runbook.
zoe (PM): Timeline: preflight = tomorrow (security + infra checks), dry-run + shadowing for 24h, canary start Thurs 09:00 PT. Please add your sign-offs in thread.
ajay (Eng): I'll add the infra PR and ensure flag ownership.
linh (Runtime): I'll wire the auto-fallback hooks.
sam (SRE): I'll schedule a war-room ping and prepare the `fallback.sh` runbook.
priya (ProdOps): I'll create the A/B config and tag rules.
emma (Data): Notebook + dashboard link will be posted by EOD.
deploy-bot: Note: scheduled deployment window created for 2026-03-26T16:00Z. Reminder will post 1h before. :robot_face:
zoe (PM): Thanks — I'll consolidate into the rollout playbook and ping legal for EU data checks. :thumbsup:
